security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: See which account every Git repo commits and pushes as.
bundle.longDescription: RepoDeck scans the folders you choose for Git repos and shows which name, email and SSH key each one commits and pushes with. It runs locally and never edits ~/.gitconfig or ~/.ssh/config.
